name: triton-bench-verifiers
description: A benchmark that tests verifier models — models that judge correctness, consistency or safety of other model outputs. It provides prompts and candidate outputs along with reference labels to measure an automated verifier's ability to detect errors, logical flaws, or policy violations. The benchmark is intended to evaluate reliability of model-based verification and calibration techniques.
reputation: Relatively small community dataset for verifier research; limited adoption beyond specialized verification/probing experiments.
